Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is the StratusCloud partner paper and an early draft of the marketplace addendum we typically present on our portal (see attachment: StratusCloud_PartnerPaper_initial.pdf). Two items to call out up front:

Subject: Re: Cloud marketplace addendum — initial partner paper and billing flow

Rishi / team — reviewed the partner paper and attached high-level redlines (see StratusCloud_PartnerPaper_redlines.pdf). Summary of legal positions and comments:

1) Pass-through billing / seller of record: Acceptable in principle for marketplace listing. We need explicit carveouts:
   - Redwood must not assume liability for marketplace operational failures (e.g., Stratus UI billing errors).
   - Any refunds initiated by Stratus that relate to Redwood product defects must be reimbursed by Redwood (we can limit to verified defects and up to a capped amount per incident).

2) Indemnity and third-party claims: Strongly recommend removing any language that obligates Redwood to indemnify Stratus for Stratus' negligence or misconduct. Indemnity should be reciprocal but narrowly scoped (IP infringement and breach of confidentiality).

3) Tax and remittance: Prefer language that states the reseller is responsible for collecting and remitting taxes arising from marketplace transactions, with Redwood providing necessary tax documentation on request.

4) Flow for Order Form/POs: We should require a short notice period (10 business days) for Stratus to notify Redwood of chargebacks that Redwood may need to reimburse; this gives us time to validate and respond.

I've flagged proposed redlines in the PDF and added explanatory notes. On the refunds/reimbursements piece, ops should weigh in on currency/settlement frequency.

Attachments: StratusCloud_PartnerPaper_redlines.pdf (pdf)

Marissa Cole
General Counsel (acting)
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud marketplace addendum — initial partner paper and billing flow

Thanks Marissa — good comments. A few operational notes / suggested compromise language that may help speed negotiation:

- Suggested pass-through snippet (for Order Form):
  "Marketplace Reseller Billing: StratusCloud will invoice end customers for Orders placed via the Stratus Marketplace. Redwood will fulfill Services. For chargebacks or refunds arising from product defects, StratusCloud will notify Redwood within ten (10) business days and provide evidence. Redwood will reimburse verified refunds within thirty (30) days, limited to amounts directly attributable to verified product defects and subject to a per-claim cap of USD 50,000. Parties agree that StratusCloud is responsible for taxes collected on marketplace transactions unless otherwise required by local law."

- Ops questions for Stratus to confirm: preferred settlement cadence (30/45/60 days), currency (USD vs localized), and whether Stratus wants Redwood to appear as the billing contact on invoices or use a "Sold by Redwood, billed by Stratus" line.

I've put a short draft of the Order Form clause into OrderForm_Draft.docx; includes the per-claim cap and 30-day reimbursement window. If legal is comfortable, we can propose this as our redline in the next outbound.

- Recommended next steps: Rishi to send consolidated counter with Marissa's high-level positions + Priyom's ops compromise. If Stratus accepts, we'll push to DocuSign with an addendum flow.

Priyom
Partner Ops, Redwood Inference

Hi Erin / Carlos — thanks for the initial paper and patience while we reviewed. Below is our consolidated counterproposal (high level) so you can share with procurement/legal on your side. If this looks acceptable we can push the addendum to DocuSign next week.

Key points (Redwood consolidated counter):
1) Marketplace billing: Stratus invoices end-customers. Redwood will fulfill Services. Parties agree that Stratus collects and remits taxes unless local law requires otherwise.
2) Refunds/Chargebacks: Stratus will notify Redwood of chargebacks/refund requests within 10 business days and include supporting evidence. Redwood will reimburse verified refunds within 30 days, limited to amounts attributable to verified Redwood product defects and subject to a per-claim cap of USD 50,000.
3) Indemnity: Indemnity to be reciprocal and limited to IP infringement and material breach; Redwood will not indemnify for Stratus' own negligence or misconduct.
4) Liability: Liability caps to remain as in the underlying MSA; marketplace-specific carveouts will be limited and mutual.
5) Operational: Propose settlement cadence: 30 days. Please confirm whether you want Redwood listed as the "Seller of Record" on invoices or prefer the "Sold by Redwood / Billed by Stratus" presentation.

Next steps:
- If agreed, we'll upload the redlined addendum and Order Form to DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/CLMKT-78
- Please provide Stratus reseller tax ID and preferred settlement currency.
- Once signed, Priyom will coordinate onboarding workflow and invoice sample mapping.

Looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive — Partnerships
Redwood Inference
